summary: Lewis Hamilton faces his Ferrari demons at Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli closes in on an early championship coronation in Austin. McLaren's tactical chess match against Ferrari intensifies as both teams vie for constructors' points with Antonelli's title bid threatening to overshadow the season's final chapters. A victory for Antonelli would crown him the youngest champion in F1 history and reshape the entire competitive landscape heading into the season's final stretch.
